title: Happy Tails Animal Shelter Volunteers
source_body:
Volunteers Wanted: Happy Tails Animal Shelter

Do you love animals? Do you want to make a difference in your community? Happy Tails Animal Shelter is looking for student volunteers!

Our shelter takes care of about 60 dogs and 25 cats that have been abandoned or lost. We need your help to give them a better life while they wait for new families.

Volunteer Activities
- Walking dogs
- Cleaning cages and feeding bowls
- Playing with cats
- Taking photos of animals for our adoption website

Requirements
- Students aged 14 or older
- Students under 16 must come with a parent or guardian.
- Volunteers must attend a one-hour training session before starting.

Schedule
- Saturdays and Sundays, 10:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.
- Volunteers should come at least twice a month.

Volunteers will receive official volunteer hours certificates (3 hours per visit).

To apply, fill out the online form on our website by October 31. If you have any questions, please call 053-987-6543.

Note: Please wear comfortable clothes that you don't mind getting dirty!

variants.prestudy:
Volunteers Wanted: Happy Tails Animal Shelter

Are you passionate about animals? Do you aspire to make a tangible difference in your local community? Happy Tails Animal Shelter is currently recruiting dedicated student volunteers!

Our facility houses approximately 60 dogs and 25 cats, all of which have been abandoned or have gone astray. We are seeking your assistance in enhancing their well-being while they await adoption into permanent homes.

Volunteer Responsibilities
- Exercising dogs on regular walks
- Sanitizing cages and feeding bowls
- Socializing with cats through play
- Photographing animals to be featured on our adoption website

Eligibility
- Applicants must be aged 14 or above.
- Those under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
- Prior to commencing any activities, all volunteers are required to attend a mandatory one-hour orientation session.

Schedule
- Saturdays and Sundays, 10:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.
- Volunteers are expected to commit to a minimum of two visits per month.

Upon completion of each visit, volunteers will be issued official certificates recognizing three hours of volunteer service.

To apply, submit the online application form on our website no later than October 31. Should you have any inquiries, please contact us at 053-987-6543.

Note: We recommend wearing comfortable attire that you would not mind getting soiled!
